name: openinterviewer
description: Open-source qualitative research platform for adaptive AI interviews, scripted demos, and BYOS deployments with Gemini, Claude, OpenAI, or OpenRouter.

paragraphs: OpenInterviewer is an open-source platform for adaptive, AI-assisted qualitative interviews. Researchers configure a study, share an opaque participant link, and review transcripts and synthesis in a dashboard. An AI interviewer conducts each interview, and the transcript is saved before any analysis runs.

The latest release is 5.4.2, which makes voice input show what it is doing and never fail silently. Version 5.4.1 fixed how Chinese and Japanese dashes display, and 5.4.0 added on-device voice input and analysis files in the study export. Read the 5.4.2, 5.4.1 and 5.4.0 release notes, or all release notes.

The project's own instance is open-interview.linxule.com. It is a standalone installation on Cloudflare, with an EU-jurisdiction workspace and provider calls through its own Cloudflare AI Gateway. The former address, openinterviewer.vercel.app, redirects there.

requirements.text: It needs no login, provider key or database.
It needs no login, provider key or database.
Researchers sign in with OAuth, then add their own AI key and Upstash database in the app.
Follow Self-host on Cloudflare for the full steps.
On Node or Vercel, you need Node.js 24.19 or newer, an Upstash Redis database, and either Vercel AI Gateway or a provider key.
Follow Self-host on Node or Vercel for the variables, the Vercel deploy and the setup checker.
